agent_report.summary: Implemented Issue #36: added an English catalogue to i18n.js with the same key set as pt-BR (key-parity tested), replaced the module-load-time `LOCALE` const with runtime `getLang()`/`setLang()` state so `t()` and all five `toLocaleDateString` call sites resolve the active language at call time, and made `t()` throw on a missing key instead of rendering `undefined`. Added a two-button PT/EN switcher in the header (aria-pressed toggle pattern, reusing the existing item-toggle convention) that re-applies static text and re-renders in place with no reload, persisting the choice to its own `antfarm.daily.lang` localStorage key (planning payload untouched). Added 12 new/updated Playwright tests covering full English rendering, per-language leftover-word guards in both directions (now also checking aria-labels/placeholders/title), EN date formatting under a forced pt-BR browser locale, persistence across reload/fresh-context/corrupt-value, planning-data byte-identity, switcher accessibility, and 360px responsiveness. Recorded the design decisions in DECISIONS.md. All 95 tests pass locally; opened PR #37 (closes #36 and #33) and CI is running.
